notes.title: Let There Be Supplies!
notes.content:
I've added a resupply mechanic, needs more tweaking but wanted to test that the multiplayer side of things is functioning well enough before steaming ahead. 

You can now walk into the cabin and stand near the window to then press E and order said supplies allowing you to refill your ammo, it isn't finalized yet so be wary that the charges don't reset for each drop yet.
